name: Is All Sin The Same
overview: Scripture teaches that all sin results in falling short of God's glory and brings the penalty of death, yet there is a distinction in the degree of sin's consequences based on knowledge and intent. While James 2:10 emphasizes that breaking even one part of the law makes a person guilty of all, Jesus' words in John 19:11 reveal that some sins carry greater responsibility. Luke 12:47 further illustrates that those who knowingly disobey face harsher judgment. Ultimately, the gift of eternal life through Christ offers redemption beyond the wages of sin (Romans 6:23), highlighting both the seriousness and the hope found in the gospel.
